name: forgejo-issues
description: Turns a Forgejo repo's issue tracker into a TODO store the agent can see and edit: open TODOs injected as context, tools to list, read, create, edit, comment and close.

forgejo_token.title: Forgejo API token
forgejo_token.description: Token used to read and write issues. Create one with only the issue scope: on the default host at https://git.danya02.ru/user/settings/applications, or the same path on your instance. Entered here it is stored in the OS secure store, never in settings.json. Leave empty to use the CLAUDE_FORGEJO_ISSUES_TOKEN environment variable or the file ~/.config/claude-forgejo-issues/token.

forge_host.title: Forge host
forge_host.description: Hostname of the Forgejo/Gitea instance, e.g. git.example.com or codeberg.org. The plugin activates in a repo only when a git remote URL points at this host.

marker_label.title: Marker label
marker_label.description: Only issues carrying this label count as agent TODOs: the hook injects only them, list shows only them, and create tags new issues with it. Created automatically on first create.

inject_on_prompt.title: Refresh the TODO list on every prompt
inject_on_prompt.description: Re-check the issue list on every prompt, not just at session start. When nothing moved since the last injection, one short line is emitted instead of the full block. Type true or false.

attribution.title: Attribute created content
attribution.description: Append a 'Written by Claude with claude-forgejo-issues' note to issues and comments the tools create, so agent-authored content is distinguishable from yours. Type true or false.

attribution_session.title: Reference the session id
attribution_session.description: Include the Claude Code session id in the attribution line, so an issue or comment can be traced back to the session that produced it. Type true or false.

request_timeout_seconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_seconds.description: How long a request to the forge may take before it is abandoned. A whole number from 1 to 30.

debug_log.title: Log errors
debug_log.description: Append internal errors to errors.ndjson in the plugin data directory. The hook and tools stay functional either way. Type true or false.
